name: Storm Lover Natsu Koi!!
source:
A lot of things can happen in two nights. The temptations of summer become irresistible when you go to the beach trip of St. Louis Academy. You can choose between keeping your boyfriend from the original game, develop a love triangle or choose one of the new boys.

[edited from [url=http://www.play-asia.com/Storm_Lover_Summer_Love/paOS-13-71-9f-49-en-70-4a44.html]Play-Asia[/url]]
translation:
短短两个夜晚，也能发生许多事情。参加圣路易斯学园的海滨旅行后，夏日诱惑将变得令人无法抗拒。你可以选择继续与本篇中的男朋友交往，也可以发展出一段三角恋，或是选择一名新登场的男生。

[根据 [url=http://www.play-asia.com/Storm_Lover_Summer_Love/paOS-13-71-9f-49-en-70-4a44.html]Play-Asia[/url]修改]
